sn51.16:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā mahiddhikā ahesuṃ mahānubhāvā || sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā || || 3.
sn51.16:1.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā mahiddhikā bhavissanti- -bahulīkatattā || || 4.
sn51.16:1.3: Ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā mahiddhikā mahānubhāvā sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā || ||
sn51.16:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.16:2.6: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā mahiddhikā ahesuṃ mahānubhāvā || pe ||
sn51.16:2.8: etarahi mahiddhikā mahānubhāvā || sabbe te imesaṃ yeva catunnam iddhipādānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā
